description: This header file declares functions related to the platform-specific implementation of a filesystem monitoring listener in the fsmonitor daemon. It provides initialization, cleanup, event loop, and shutdown functions that are meant to be implemented for each backend backend.

methods.name: fsm_listen__ctor
methods.description: Initializes platform-specific data for the fsmonitor listener thread; called before starting the listener thread.

methods.name: fsm_listen__dtor
methods.description: Cleans up platform-specific data for the fsmonitor listener thread after it has been joined.

methods.name: fsm_listen__loop
methods.description: Main event loop for platform-specific filesystem event watching; run in the listener thread.

methods.name: fsm_listen__stop_async
methods.description: Requests the listener thread to shut down gracefully without waiting.
